_comment: Shared corpus for the two twin implementations of source-prose normalisation: pipeline/search/textnorm.py and ui_kits/app/activity-view.js. Both are asserted against these exact expectations, so a rule added to one side can never silently drift from the other.

cases.why: the real Meetup case: Markdown body, Chinese text
cases.input: **Bringing Dubai AI to Shanghai** 我们每周六 19:30 线下聚会
cases.expected: Bringing Dubai AI to Shanghai 我们每周六 19:30 线下聚会

cases.why: `\w` matches CJK in Python but not in JS — the boundary guard must be ASCII in both
double-escaped JSON leftovers
cases.input: \*\*Bringing Dubai AI\*\*\n我们每周六 19:30 线下聚会
cases.expected:
Bringing Dubai AI
我们每周六 19:30 线下聚会

cases.why: a second marker on the same line must still be reached
two markers with no trailing space: a greedy inner group would swallow both
bold+italic collapses to the bare word
markers separated by punctuation instead of a space
an unpaired run is a leftover MARKER, not content — half-stripping it (a*b*c) was the shipped defect
an italic closer must not eat one asterisk out of a `**` run and strand the other
the organiser's own inline bullet stars — the punctuation-positioned ones are markup and go; the one after a word is indistinguishable from prose and stays
cases.input: after the discussion closes. *19:30 - 21:30: Venue in the group * 21:30+ After-Hours: we move on. * Cost: Free
cases.expected: after the discussion closes. 19:30 - 21:30: Venue in the group * 21:30+ After-Hours: we move on. Cost: Free

cases.why: a bullet star straight after punctuation with no space, and a line-start bullet
cases.input:
actually want?* * How to share revenue
* Meetup Pages: https://x.test
cases.expected:
actually want? * How to share revenue
Meetup Pages: https://x.test

cases.why: a bullet rule must not eat the asterisk in multiplication
an italic pair is resolved before the bullet rule sees it
cases.input: 备注：*重要* 请提前到场
cases.expected: 备注：重要 请提前到场

cases.why: a bold pair whose closing marker is followed by a digit never pairs, so it was left on screen
cases.input: the discussion closes. **19:30–21:30. Venue in the group**21:30. After-Hours:
cases.expected: the discussion closes. 19:30–21:30. Venue in the group21:30. After-Hours:

cases.why: the real shipped defect: markers sitting next to punctuation
cases.expected: Cost: Free(Come as a regular customer).

cases.why: a heading marker stranded mid-line by a flattened source
cases.input: ideas.What this event is about: ## The Venue
cases.expected: ideas.What this event is about: The Venue

cases.why: "#1" in an event title is not a heading marker
cases.input: 参加 #1 上海最佳活动 — Join #1 Top Best Event
cases.expected: 参加 #1 上海最佳活动 — Join #1 Top Best Event

cases.why: multiplication is not emphasis
snake_case must survive the underscore rule
an unknown backslash escape is left verbatim (Windows path)
links keep their text, drop their syntax
cases.expected: 报名见 官网 页面

cases.why: images carry no information without the picture
heading, blockquote and rule markers
blockquote marker
a horizontal rule is a paragraph separator
code fences and inline code
inline code
strikethrough
italic
cases.expected: 报名 免费 入场

cases.why: whitespace tidying, paragraph collapses to two newlines
single-line mode flattens paragraphs
ordinary Chinese prose is untouched
